      "effect": "layout"
    },

        "Keep p = 3 fixed and double beta from 1 to 64 every 100 iterations."

      "effect": "layout"

    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",

      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria updates with a density move limit of 0.2 per iteration.",
        "Optimality-criteria updates with a density move limit of 0.05 per iteration.",
        "MMA updates with a density move limit of 0.1 per iteration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial design",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No initialization is given for the optimization in Sec. 4 or for a direct single-material replacement.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform density equal to the selected nominal volume fraction.",
        "Uniform density at the selected fraction plus a zero-mean 1-percent random perturbation generated with seed 0."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization stopping criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies only 'until convergence'; no monitored quantity, tolerance, persistence requirement, or iteration cap is supplied.",

        "Stop when the maximum density change is below 0.01.",
        "Stop when the maximum density change is below 0.001.",
        "Stop when relative compliance change remains below 1e-4 for ten iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element formulation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.2 and its captions specify element counts and mesh sizes, but not displacement interpolation order or quadrature.",

      "effect": "layout"

      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
